integrity: The mathematical equivalence is established symbolically; check.py gives independent exact-arithmetic demonstrations but is not an infinite verification. No independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Characterization applies only to finite integer support. An unrelated infinite-support law may be strongly monotone. All-tilt monotonicity is necessary; ordinary monotonicity alone is strictly weaker. Absolute originality against unindexed classical analytic-polynomial literature is not certified.
title: Finite strong characteristic-function monotonicity characterizes Bernoulli sums
